title: Switch a Rune Without Losing the Extended Set

steps.intent: open Runes, press Modify, press Extend Set on a generated set and name the new set in the Extend Set Name field
in the extended set, press a rune's State switch until it reads State: Off; open More Runes and check an addable rune's switch reads State: Off or State: On
press Extend Set on another set, then press Escape in the Extend Set Name field to cancel halfway
check the extended set I made is still there, still the set in use, and the rune I switched keeps its State
